info.name: Greyon Hotel Booking API
info.description: Routes organized from web.php, auth.php, admin.php, developer.php. Session-cookie auth (Breeze-style, no Sanctum) across three guards (web/admin/developer) — turn cookies on (default), log in once under Developer > Auth, Admin > Auth or Front > Auth, and every other request in that guard authenticates automatically via the shared cookie jar. What an admin can do is entirely determined by the packages a developer assigns them (Developer > Admins > Update Admin — Packages) — see README.md's Architecture section.

item.name: Login with Google (open in browser, not Bruno)

request.description: This is a browser redirect flow (Google's consent screen), so Bruno's Send button can't complete it. Paste {{base_url}}/auth/google/redirect into an actual browser tab instead; Google sends it back to /auth/google/callback, which logs the guest in and hands back the same cookie session every other request here uses.
